purpose: give the four arms side by side with exact values
takeaway: A1 cuts tokens and keeps answerability but is lower on accuracy; A3 is cheapest but loses answerability.
comparison_the_eye_must_make: A1 against A0 and against A2 and A3
uncertainty_shown: none in the table; interval and test are in the text and Figure 1
non_conclusions: accuracy, answerability and route@1 cover seeds 66 to 110 only
caption: Global search (A0) and ownership frozen at its prior (A2) cost about the same, learned-ownership routing (A1) costs fewer tokens per query with equal answerability but lower accuracy, and similarity routing (A3) is cheapest but answers far fewer queries.
